main.title: Notifications
main.hint: A short message to your phone or a webhook at the flight's milestones

enabled.label: Send notifications
enabled.hint: Off: nothing leaves this PC. On: each target below gets the milestones it has ticked.
enabled.more: Milestones: refuel complete · boarding complete · final loadsheet sent · ready for pushback · cabin secure · deice holdover expiring · top of descent approaching · landed · on blocks · deboarding complete. Each fires once per flight; a revised final loadsheet fires again. A slow or dead target never delays the ground automation or the First Officer — sends run in the background with a 5 second limit, and a failing target is left alone for a minute.

cooldown.label: Failure cooldown
cooldown.hint: How long a target is left alone after a failed send.

timeout.label: Send timeout
timeout.hint: Per send. A slow service is treated as failed after this.

holdover.label: Holdover warning
holdover.hint: Minutes of deice holdover time left when 'holdover expiring' is sent.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Your label for it — what the log and the result line show.

kind.label: Kind
kind.hint: ntfy = a topic on ntfy.sh or your own server. Discord = a channel webhook. Webhook = any https address that takes a JSON POST (schema in docs/integrations/notifications.md).

token.label: Bearer token
token.hint: Optional. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer …'. Stored encrypted on this PC; never logged.

test.label: Send test
test.hint: One test message to this target now, with the values above (save first if you changed them). Works with notifications off.

kindHint.ntfy: ntfy topic — the phone app subscribes to it
kindHint.webhook: JSON POST to your own endpoint

urlHint.ntfy: The full topic URL. Treat it as a secret — anyone with it can read or post; stored encrypted.
urlHint.discord: The channel's webhook URL from Discord → Channel settings → Integrations. It carries its own secret; stored encrypted.
urlHint.webhook: An https address that accepts a JSON POST. Stored encrypted.

empty.title: Targets
empty.text: No targets yet — add your phone's ntfy topic or a webhook.
